description.value: Anna's Cake House is a family-owned Hong Kong-style bakery founded in 1974 by the Cheung family, now celebrating 50 years of baking in Greater Vancouver. The shop is known for fresh cakes and buns made daily with no artificial additives or preservatives, using Canadian butter, cream, and local seasonal ingredients. With over 15 cake flavours made to order the day they are needed, it is a well-loved community institution with a loyal multigenerational following.
